name: Statues
overview: Scripture firmly prohibits the making and worship of statues or graven images, emphasizing that God alone is to be glorified and praised, not any likeness crafted by human hands (Exodus 20:4; Leviticus 26:1; Isaiah 42:8). Idols, often made of silver and gold, represent the futile work of men and cannot substitute for the living God (Psalms 115:4). The Word of God, rather than physical objects or worldly kingdoms, is the true sustenance for life and worship (Matthew 4:4, 4:8).
